Name: Simple Crop and Artisan Good Harvest Multiplier
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]✦ Simple Crop and Artisan Goods Harvest Multiplier ✦[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]This mod is made for PC. Android compatibility has not been tested.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#FDE68A]💡 Requested by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Harold45]Harold45[/url]. Ingredient-quality suggestion by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DasianSensation]DasianSensation[/url].[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Choose separate harvest chances and quantity multipliers for crops, fruit trees and artisan goods. Optionally let five artisan machines inherit ingredient quality.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🌾 Harvest Quantities[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Crops:[/b] standard hand and scythe harvesting, regrowing and trellis crops, and Junimo collection.
[b]Fruit trees:[/b] harvest fruit by shaking mature trees, with separate chance and quantity settings.
[b]Artisan goods:[/b] collect extra products from supported standard machine interactions, including Kegs, Preserves Jars, Cheese Presses, Mayonnaise Machines, Bee Houses, Looms, Oil Makers and Casks.

Extra items go to your backpack, with overflow dropped nearby. Junimo extras go to the hut. Failed collections grant no bonus; partial collections multiply only the quantity received.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]⚙ Choose Your Multipliers[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Each of the three groups has independent controls:
[b]Chance: 0–100%[/b] · [b]Minimum: 1–100×[/b] · [b]Maximum: 1–200×[/b]

Defaults are [b]100% chance and 1× minimum/maximum[/b], so quantities stay normal until you configure them. Set minimum and maximum to 2 for fixed 2× output. Set chance to 0% to disable one group. A maximum below the minimum is raised to match it.

Example: 25% chance with a 2–4× range gives each successful supported harvest a 25% chance for two to four times its collected output.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]⭐ Optional Ingredient Quality[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Enable [b]Inherit ingredient quality[/b] to let new batches use the higher of the main ingredient quality and the recipe’s normal output quality.

[b]Iridium wheat → iridium beer.[/b]
[b]Normal large milk → gold cheese[/b], because the native recipe already produces gold quality.

Choose machines individually: [b]Kegs, Preserves Jars, Cheese Presses, Mayonnaise Machines and Dehydrators.[/b]

The option is [b]Off by default[/b] and works independently of the quantity multipliers. Fuel and secondary ingredients do not determine quality. Existing batches are not rewritten, and Cask aging is excluded. If another mod should control artisan quality, leave this option Off.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]⚙ Settings[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional and provides the settings screen. Without it, edit config.json while the game is closed. Settings text is included in twelve languages; new translations are AI-assisted.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🛠 Requirements & Installation[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.0+[/url].
Back up your save, extract [b]SimpleHarvestMultiplier[/b] into Mods, and launch through SMAPI. When updating, replace the old mod files and keep your existing config.json. Crop Reseed is not required.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🔗 Compatibility & Scope[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]PC single-player only.[/b] The mod’s effects are disabled in multiplayer and split-screen.

Data-driven custom crops and artisan-category products can receive quantity bonuses through the supported native collection paths. Quality inheritance is limited to the five machines listed above. Automate and custom automation are not integrated or verified; mods that replace harvesting or machine output need individual checks.

Giant crops, ordinary forage pickups, ginger digging, quest items, crop byproducts such as seeds/hay, and lightning coal from fruit trees are excluded.

Test on a copied save before using it with your full modpack. Live full-modpack and physical-controller testing remain pending.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Please share reports and ideas on this mod’s page.
[b]Bugs:[/b] include the mod version, game/SMAPI version and platform, expected versus actual behavior, reproduction steps, and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]shared SMAPI log[/url]. Add a screenshot or short video if helpful.
[b]Suggestions:[/b] tell me what you would like changed or added and how it would improve the mod.[/color][/size][/center]
